# QS-CFW-7661-91 — Quality specification - track link CFW-7661-91 (15B37)

Revision: Rev D  
Plant: P1  
Parts: CFW-7661-91

Scope
This specification defines the quality acceptance criteria and inspection requirements for forged track link CFW-7661-91 (15B37) manufactured at Plant P1. It applies to finished forgings delivered for machining and assembly and establishes measurable acceptance limits for hardness, bore tolerance, and forging weight.

Requirements table
| Characteristic | Requirement |
|---|---|
| Hardness | The hardness range for track link CFW-7661-91 (CFW-7661-91) is 39-42 HRC. |
| Bore diameter tolerance | The bore diameter tolerance for track link CFW-7661-91 (CFW-7661-91) is ±0.02 mm. |
| Maximum forging weight | The maximum forging weight for track link CFW-7661-91 (CFW-7661-91) is 28.0 kg. |

Inspection method
- Hardness: Verify hardness using a calibrated Rockwell hardness tester on prepared sample surfaces per standard practice for HRC measurement. Record locations and readings on the inspection record. Report any reading outside the stated range in the inspection report.
- Bore: Measure bore diameter using a calibrated internal gauge or bore micrometer. Measurement must be made at the specified production inspection location to ensure representative results. Report the measurement and compare to the bore diameter tolerance.
- Weight: Weigh the finished forging on a calibrated scale. Record gross part weight and confirm it does not exceed the maximum forging weight.

Nonconformance handling
- Any part failing to meet the requirements in the table is nonconforming. Mark and segregate nonconforming parts immediately to prevent unintended use.
- Initiate a nonconformance report and include part identification, measured values, inspector, and disposition recommendation.
- Disposition options include rework (if corrective action can demonstrably bring the part into conformance without compromising integrity), use-as-is with customer-approved concession, or scrap.
- Notify quality management for review of trends if multiple nonconformances occur.
